'''Bryan Batdorf''' (Players Committee forum handle '''Lord Helmet''') is a [[Star Wars CCG]] player.<ref name="pcf-3078-44084">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44084#44084 Is this game dead??], Bryan Batdorf (Lord Helmet), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040427135016/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44074%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In April 2004 his forum signature read "Founder, Team Stephenville", and he wrote that his town in Texas had only four players, who played every week.<ref name="pcf-3078-44084" /> According to his forum signature (captured April 2005), he was runner-up at the 2004 Texas State Championship in both Open and Classic.<ref name="pcf-4613-63542">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63542#63542 New Design Advocate!], Bryan Batdorf (Lord Helmet), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050416235209/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63182%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He and [[Blake Huffman]] received the Day 2 automatic bids to the [[2008 World Championship]] from the [[2008 Dantooine Regionals]] of 21 June 2008.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
